title: An Inventory container
hints: Keep one private dict, self._by_serial, mapping serial -> Device. Every method reads or writes that dict.
dict.pop(key) raises KeyError when the key is missing and returns the value otherwise, which is exactly what remove() needs. dict[key] does the same for __getitem__.
__iter__ can simply `return iter(self._by_serial.values())`. In __contains__, branch on isinstance(item, Device) vs isinstance(item, str) and answer False for anything else.
